commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='eb10cdd70039e82d09cc03231b52ad851fe42546'; TAG='v1.0.0-phase3-pre-field.1'; git fetch --no-tags origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test -z "$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${TAG}" "refs/tags/${TAG}^{}")"; if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/${TAG}"; then echo "local target tag unexpectedly exists: ${TAG}" >&2; exit 3; fi; git tag -a "${TAG}" "${EXPECTED}" -m 'Phase 3 pre-field golden candidate'; OBJ=$(git rev-parse "${TAG}"); PEELED=$(git rev-parse "${TAG}^{}"); TYPE=$(git cat-file -t "${TAG}"); test "${PEELED}" = "${EXPECTED}"; test "${TYPE}" = 'tag'; git push origin "refs/tags/${TAG}"; REMOTE=$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${TAG}^{}" | awk '{print $1}'); test "${REMOTE}" = "${EXPECTED}"; printf 'tag=%s
object=%s
peeled=%s
type=%s
remote_peeled=%s
' "${TAG}" "${OBJ}" "${PEELED}" "${TYPE}" "${REMOTE}"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
